newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Leer, Dow Chemical in drum deal.
newsitem.headline: Van Leer, Dow Chemical in drum deal.

text.p: Dutch packaging group Van Leer said on Wednesday it had signed a long-term, worldwide contract to supply large steel drums to Dow Chemical Co.
Van Leer gave no financial details of the contract but said it would supply drums to 40 locations in 20 countries with its deliveries to Dow Chemical doubling during the contract period.
The deal will lower costs through greater standardisation and longer production runs. Dow will reduce the types of steel drum it uses from 300 to just 10, based on one specification.
The resulting reduction in costs make the contract attractive to both companies, Van Leer said.
